h: Tinubu asks Sunday Igboho to deploy his security network in the South-West
p: President Tinubu reportedly asked activist Sunday Igboho to use his Iru Ekun Security Network to help protect lives and property in the South-West. The two met briefly in the president's car after the Ibadan rally.
body: President Bola Tinubu has reportedly asked Yoruba nation activist Sunday Adeyemo, popularly known as Sunday Igboho, to deploy his Iru Ekun Security Network to help protect lives and property across South-West Nigeria.

According to a statement released on Monday, 23 November 2026, by Igboho's media office in Ibadan, the two met briefly inside the president's official car after the APC presidential campaign rally at Mapo Hall, Ibadan, on Saturday.
The meeting is said to have focused on the work of Iru Ekun, a community security outfit founded by Igboho, and how its members could help reduce insecurity in rural and urban areas of the region.
Igboho is a well-known campaigner for Yoruba self-determination. The meeting took place on the day of Tinubu's campaign rally in Ibadan, where the president also met traditional rulers.
more: They met in the president's car in Ibadan.
Iru Ekun is Igboho's community security outfit.
The statement came from Igboho's media office.
